title: VA Building 28 (AF101) — Division 9 flooring area takeoff
prompt: On the VA St. Cloud Health Care System, Building 28 First Floor Finish Plan (sheet AF101), perform a Division 9 flooring takeoff. Set the drawing scale first (a graphic scale bar is at the bottom of the sheet; nominal 1/8" = 1'-0"). Then measure the total floor area for each finish condition and report each in SF: (1) WD-1 = wood / luxury-vinyl flooring, and (2) VCT-1 = vinyl composition tile. Report the measured base area per finish (no waste, no multiplier).
